title: settings.json
description: User settings, written by CrossPointSettings (src/CrossPointSettings.cpp) to /.crosspoint/settings.json. Most keys come from getSettingsList() in src/SettingsList.h; board-specific entries are only written on boards that have them. Every key is optional: missing keys keep their default, out-of-range enums and toggles fall back to the default, and out-of-range values are clamped.

homeButtonAction.description: HomeButtonAction: 0 = home, 1 = ignore, 2 = next page, 3 = force refresh, 4 = footnotes, 5 = confirm, 6 = KOReader sync, 7 = bookmark, 8 = dictionary, 9 = reader menu, 10 = toggle frontlight. Written only on boards with a home key.

frontButtonHardware.description: Physical front button index: 0 = back, 1 = confirm, 2 = left, 3 = right. If any two remap keys collide, all four reset to the identity mapping.

sleepScreen.description: 0 = dark, 1 = light, 2 = custom, 3 = cover, 4 = cover + custom, 5 = none, 6 = quick resume, 7 = transparent custom.

refreshFrequency.description: Pages between full e-ink refreshes: 0 = 1, 1 = 5, 2 = 10, 3 = 15, 4 = 30, 5 = never.

fadingFix.description: Sunlight fading compensation. Not written on touch boards.

frontlightRestoreOnWake.description: Restore the saved frontlight on/off state after boot or wake. Frontlight boards only.

fontFamily.description: Built-in reader font: 0 = Noto Serif, 1 = Noto Sans. Ignored while sdFontFamilyName is set. Legacy value 2 (OpenDyslexic) migrates to sdFontFamilyName "OpenDyslexic".

fontSize.description: Reader font point size, snapped to the nearest size the active family ships. Legacy files stored a slot 0..3 (small..extra large), which migrates to 12/14/16/18 pt.

sdFontFamilyName.description: Selected SD card font family (folder name). Omitted when a built-in family is selected.

screenMargin.description: Reader margin in pixels, set in steps of 5.

paragraphAlignment.description: 0 = justify, 1 = left, 2 = center, 3 = right, 4 = book's style.

focusReadingEnabled.description: Bold the first part of each word.

orientation.description: 0 = portrait, 1 = landscape clockwise, 2 = inverted, 3 = landscape counter-clockwise.

dictionaryName.description: Selected dictionary folder under /dictionaries. Omitted when none is selected.

sideButtonLayout.description: 0 = up is previous, 1 = up is next, 2 = disabled.

touchReaderControls.description: 0 = off, 1 = tap, 2 = swipe, 3 = inverted tap. Touch boards only.

longPressWordLookup.description: Long-press a word in the reader to look it up; hides Look Up from the reader menu. Touch boards only.

tapForReaderMenu.description: How the reader menu opens: 0 = off, 1 = center tap, 2 = bottom-edge swipe up. Home-key boards only.

longPressButtonBehavior.description: Page-turn button long press: 0 = off, 1 = chapter skip, 2 = orientation change.

longPressMenuFunction.description: Long-press Confirm in the reader: 0 = KOReader sync, 1 = disabled, 2 = bookmark, 3 = dictionary, 4 = reader menu (home-key boards only). On home-key boards, used once to migrate into homeButtonLongPressAction.

doubleClickPwrLight.description: Double-click power toggles the frontlight. X4 Pro only.

shortPwrBtn.description: Short power press: 0 = ignore, 1 = sleep, 2 = page turn, 3 = force refresh, 4 = footnotes, 5 = confirm (touch boards only).

tiltPageTurn.description: 0 = off, 1 = normal, 2 = inverted. Boards with the QMI8658 IMU only.

backShortToFileBrowser.description: Short Back goes to the file browser instead of home. Not written on touch boards.

sleepTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity before sleep; 31 = never.

sleepTimeout.description: Legacy sleep timeout enum (0 = 1 min, 1 = 5, 2 = 10, 3 = 15, 4 = 30). Read only when sleepTimeoutMinutes is absent.

libraryUseMetadata.description: Show title and author from book metadata instead of the filename.

opdsDownloadFolder.description: Destination folder for OPDS downloads; empty = SD root.

opdsFilenameFormat.description: OPDS download file name: 0 = Author - Title, 1 = Title - Author, 2 = Title.

xtcStatusBarMode.description: Status bar in XTC books: 0 = hidden, 1 = bottom, 2 = top.

clockUtcOffsetQ.description: Legacy UTC offset in quarter hours, biased by 48 (48 = UTC+0). Only used to migrate into clockTimezone while that is unset.

clockTimezone.description: Index into the append-only timezone table in src/util/Timezones.cpp; 255 = unset.

clockDst.description: 0 = follow the timezone's DST rule, 1 = force on, 2 = force off.

clockShowHeader.description: Show the clock in header bands opposite the battery.

clockHasBeenSynced.description: Set after the first successful NTP sync; 0 forces a re-sync on the next WiFi connect.

language.description: UI language code (the _language_code of a file in lib/I18n/translations/, e.g. "EN", "DE"). Unknown codes fall back to English.

keyboardLayouts.description: Bitmask over keyboard_layouts::ALL. Omitted while unconfigured, which means the UI language's layout plus English.
